verdict.rationale: Notion's own database capability is documented: databases can be created and updated, and webhooks reference property changes. Community users report running project and task tracking in Notion and describe it as sitting between JIRA-style PM tools and wikis. The pack never shows the specific fields this story needs, so tracking initiatives is plausible but not concretely evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of status, priority, and owner/team properties on database items; an initiative-tracking template or view; hands-on evidence of PM initiative tracking with an owning team.
